newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Southwest Gas plans 225 mln pesos lpg plants.
newsitem.headline: Southwest Gas plans 225 mln pesos lpg plants.

text.p: The U.S.-based Southwest Gas Corp said on Saturday it will invest 225 million pesos to put up nine refilling plants for liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) in the Philippines.

In a statement, the company said each plant will be built to handle 1,800 to 2,400 11-kg LPG cylinders per day. The first of the nine plants was inaugurated earlier today by the firm in the northern province of Tarlac.
Southwest said it plans to start commercial operation of the four other plants by March 1997, and the remaining four up to the end of next year.
The facilities of Southwest will serve the LPG requirements of oil refiner Pilipinas Shell Petroleum Corp, the local unit of the Shell Group of Companies.
